title: Ultrametric criterion by norms of natural numbers
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] with a multiplicative real norm: $\|x\|\geq0$, $\|x\|=0$ if and only if $x=0$, $\|1\|=1$, $\|xy\|=\|x\|\|y\|$, and $\|x+y\|\leq\|x\|+\|y\|$. Equip $K$ with the induced distance $d(x,y)=\|x-y\|$. Then its distance is ultrametric, meaning $d(x,z)\leq\max(d(x,y),d(y,z))$ for all $x,y,z\in K$, if and only if $\|(n:K)\|\leq1$ for every natural number $n$.
